info.name: Dynamic Agent Routing API
info.description:
Test collection for the langchain4j-dynamic-agent-routing Spring Boot app.

**Endpoints**
- `GET /api/ai-support` — General AI chat (JavaTechieAIAgent, no tools)
- `GET /api/ai-support/order` — Order support AI (OrderSupportAIAgent, with tools: getOrderStatus, cancelOrder)
- `GET /api/ai-support/workflow` — Static multi-agent workflow (WorkflowSupportAgent: OrderAgent -> ShippingAgent -> RefundAgent -> ResponseAgent, with tools: getOrderStatus, trackShipment, checkRefundEligibility)
- `GET /api/ai-support/supervisor` — Dynamic agent routing (SupervisorAgent: an LLM supervisor decides at runtime which sub-agents to invoke)

**Setup**
1. Start the app (runs on the Spring Boot default port 8080).
2. Update the `baseUrl` / `orderId*` collection variables (Collection → Variables) with your values.
3. Watch the app console for `TOOL CALLED -> ...` and `=== AGENT START/END ===` logs to confirm tool and agent invocation.

**Static vs dynamic**: the `/workflow` endpoint always runs every agent in a fixed sequence; the `/supervisor` endpoint picks only the agents the request actually needs (e.g. a shipping-only question skips RefundAgent).

**Error scenarios note**: tool errors (order not found / cancel shipped / missing refund policy / missing shipment tracking) may return either `200` (LLM handles the tool error gracefully) or `500` (exception propagates) depending on the langchain4j version — the tests accept both.

item.name: 3. Static Multi-Agent Workflow
item.description: Requests against `GET /api/ai-support/workflow` — WorkflowSupportAgent, a fixed sequence OrderAgent -> ShippingAgent -> RefundAgent -> ResponseAgent. Every request runs all four agents; watch the console for === AGENT START/END === and TOOL CALLED -> lines.

url.raw: {{baseUrl}}/api/ai-support/workflow?request=Can I get a refund for my order {{orderId1}}?

query.value: Can I get a refund for my order {{orderId1}}?

request.description: Runs the whole pipeline: order details -> shipping details -> refund decision -> final response. The answer should combine the real order record and the refund policy row.

exec: pm.test("Response body is not empty", function () {

url.raw: {{baseUrl}}/api/ai-support/workflow?request=Where is my order {{orderId3}} and what is the tracking number?

query.value: Where is my order {{orderId3}} and what is the tracking number?

request.description: Even though the user only asked about shipping, the fixed pipeline also runs the refund agent. The final answer must include the tracking number (TRK-DL-550102) and must NOT mention refunds unless asked.

exec: pm.test("Response body is not empty", function () {
pm.test("Answer includes the tracking number", function () {

item.name: 4. Supervisor Dynamic Routing
item.description: Requests against `GET /api/ai-support/supervisor` — SupervisorAgent. An LLM supervisor reads the request and the @Agent descriptions, then decides which sub-agents to invoke. Contrast with folder 3: single-topic questions here should skip irrelevant agents.

url.raw: {{baseUrl}}/api/ai-support/supervisor?request=What is the status of my order {{orderId1}}?

query.value: What is the status of my order {{orderId1}}?

request.description: A pure order-status question — the supervisor should invoke OrderAgent (plus ResponseAgent for the final answer) and skip RefundAgent and ShippingAgent. Check the console agent logs to confirm.

exec: pm.test("Response body is not empty", function () {

url.raw: {{baseUrl}}/api/ai-support/supervisor?request=What is the tracking number and current location of my shipment for order {{orderId3}}?

query.value: What is the tracking number and current location of my shipment for order {{orderId3}}?

request.description: A shipping-only question — the supervisor should NOT need RefundAgent here. Compare with 3.2, where the fixed workflow always runs every agent. The answer should include tracking number TRK-DL-550102.

exec: pm.test("Response body is not empty", function () {
pm.test("Answer includes the tracking number", function () {
